allowed_hosts.description: List of trusted hosts/IPs allowed to connect (empty = all hosts).

items.description: Allowed IP addresses or hostnames (CIDR notation allowed).

auth_modules.description: Ordered list of authentication modules to load.

items.description: Authentication backend modules; choose based on your identity provider.

enable_acl.description: Enable IMAP ACL extension for folder-level access control.

enable_quota.description: Enable IMAP QUOTA extension to report and enforce mailbox size limits.

enabled_extensions.description: List of IMAP extensions to enable and announce in CAPABILITY.

items.description: IMAP extension names to advertise (IMAP4rev1 is mandatory).

extra_options.description: Map of additional key=value-style configuration directives.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds before an idle IMAP connection times out (requires IDLE extension).

imapd_login_wait.description: Seconds to wait for client authentication before disconnecting.

imapd_startup_wait.description: Seconds to wait for daemon startup (internal timeout).

mail_format.description: Mail storage format: 'maildir' (per-message files) or 'mbox' (single file per mailbox).

mail_root.description: Top-level directory where user mailboxes are stored (must match MTA spool path).

max_daemon.description: Maximum number of IMAP daemon processes allowed system-wide.

max_message_size.description: Maximum allowed message size in bytes (0 = unlimited).

max_per_ip.description: Maximum number of concurrent IMAP connections per IP address.

require_ssl_for_plaintext.description: Disallow plaintext authentication if SSL/TLS is not in use.

ssl_ca_certificate_path.description: Optional path to CA certificate for client certificate verification.

ssl_certificate_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate and private key (PEM format).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS support for IMAP connections.

ssl_port.description: Port number for SSL/TLS-enabled IMAP (standard port: 993).

ssl_require_auth.description: Require authentication only over SSL/TLS (prevent plaintext passwords).
